headline: ISS RECOMMENDS 'FOR': Proxy firm backs G Mining Ventures' acquisition of G2 Goldfields ahead of June 16 shareholder vote
snippet: ISS — the leading independent proxy advisory firm — recommended G2 Goldfields (TSX:GTWO) shareholders vote FOR the plan of arrangement with G Mining Ventures (TSX:GMIN), creating a tier-one gold mining hub in Guyana. ISS called the process robust and the implied value the best G2 shareholders have seen since 2011; proxy voting deadline is June 12.

headline: REALLOYS BUILDS LARGEST HREE FACILITY OUTSIDE CHINA — $20.6M investment in Saskatchewan locks up Dy, Tb, NdPr output
snippet: REalloys (NASDAQ:ALOY) invested $20.6M into the Saskatchewan Research Council's rare earth processing facility in Saskatoon, securing exclusive rights to 80% of expanded capacity — including 525 tonnes per year of NdPr plus commercial-scale dysprosium and terbium output — building the largest heavy rare earth metallization facility outside China as the Pentagon's 2027 ban on Chinese REE material approaches.

headline: 'FAKE AND INCORRECT': India's RBI denies selling $12B in gold; 880 tonnes of physical holdings unchanged
snippet: India's Finance Ministry and Reserve Bank jointly denied a Bloomberg Economics analysis claiming the RBI sold $12 billion in gold to defend its currency amid Middle East oil-price shocks, issuing an official statement that physical gold holdings remain unchanged at 880.52 metric tonnes and calling the report "fake and incorrect."

headline: USA RARE EARTH secures up to $1.6B from US Commerce Department to build mine-to-magnet rare earth chain
snippet: USA Rare Earth (NASDAQ:USAR) executed definitive agreements with the US Department of Commerce under the CHIPS Act for $277M in federal funding and up to $1.3B in senior secured loans, funding its Round Top Mountain mine, Texas and Oklahoma magnet plants — bringing total committed capital to approximately $3.5B across public and private sources.

headline: SILVER ACADIA intercepts 24.8 metres at 328.9 g/t Ag at Hachey Zone, Nicholas-Denys, New Brunswick
snippet: Silver Acadia Exploration (CSE:SLA) released Phase 1 hole ND26-005 intercepting 24.8 metres of 328.9 g/t silver and 1.0 g/t gold at its Nicholas-Denys property in New Brunswick, confirming continuity of the Hachey Zone — a high-grade epithermal silver-gold-zinc-lead system with more than 3 kilometres of mineralized strike.

headline: AYA GOLD & SILVER hits 1,867 g/t Ag over 6 metres at Zgounder pit depth; 5,100 g/t Ag core confirms resource expansion
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver (TSX:AYA) reported hole ZG-RC-26-946 intercepting 1,867 g/t silver over 6 metres at depth in its Zgounder Silver Mine in Morocco — including a 5,100 g/t Ag core over 2 metres — the strongest evidence yet for at-depth resource extension below the current open pit footprint.

headline: AMERICAS GOLD & SILVER drills 599.8 g/t Ag over 14m at Cosalá Complex; resource upgrade to follow in H2 2026
snippet: Americas Gold and Silver (NYSE:USAS) released infill results from its Cosalá Complex in Mexico showing 599.8 g/t silver and 0.8% copper over 14.0 metres and 509.7 g/t Ag over 10.0 metres — substantially above the current resource model — from three zones all post-dating the October 2025 resource cutoff and pointing squarely at an upward revision.

headline: CHILE COPPER OUTPUT PLUNGES 14% in April, extending seven-month production slide as ore grades deteriorate
snippet: Chile's copper production dropped 13.8% year-on-year to 399,954 metric tonnes in April 2026 — the seventh consecutive monthly decline — as falling ore grades and disruptions at major operations drag on the world's largest copper-producing nation ahead of a critical US tariff decision by June 30.

headline: ROCKHAVEN APPROVED to direct-ship high-grade gold-silver ore from Klaza's Western BRX Zone, Yukon — bulk sample begins June
snippet: The Yukon government issued a permit allowing Rockhaven Resources (TSXV:RK) to extract and direct-ship high-grade mineralized material from 460 metres of strike at the Western BRX zone of its Klaza gold-silver deposit, with the 2026 bulk sample program running through September — a key de-risking step before resource delineation drilling.

headline: STERLING METALS swallows QcX Gold in all-stock deal, forging a 35,000-hectare Batchewana Copper Belt land package
snippet: Sterling Metals (TSXV:SAG) agreed to acquire QcX Gold (TSXV:QCX) in an all-stock arrangement, creating a consolidated 35,000+ hectare land position across northern Ontario's Batchewana Copper Belt — expanding its flagship Soo Copper Project footprint by approximately 40% and adding multiple untested copper-gold targets from the historic Tribag mining camp.
